noSeriesAvailable.title: No series available
noSeriesAvailable.text: You have not registered a series yet. To register a new series, please visit the web interface. For further information on registering a series, please consult the registration and administration guide.

completed.heading: Upload completed
completed.text: The files were successfully uploaded. They are now being prepared for streaming. Once the processing is complete, you will receive an email for each file with information about the publishing options. Please note that depending on the length and size of the uploaded videos, processing may take several hours.

alert.title: Invalid File Format
alert.text: The file format is not supported. Please upload only audio and video files.
